for the State.
3. Put up this matter on 07.10.2026, as 
fresh in order to enable the State Counsel to 
get instructions what evidence has been 
collected by the I.O. against each of the 
accused, since, in this case in total 30 
persons have been charge sheeted and also

Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel for 
the applicants. 
Ms. Meenakshi Sharma, learned A.G.A. 
for the State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned 
counsel for respondent no. 2.
2. On the previous occasion, the 
Coordinate Bench of this Court directed the 
State to obtain instructions regarding the 
evidence collected by the Investigating 
Officer against each of the accused, as 30% 
of the accused persons had been charge￾sheeted in the present case.
3. Pursuant to the aforesaid direction, 
learned A.G.A., on the basis of the 
instructions received, submitted that 30% of 
the accused persons had been charge￾sheeted on the basis of CCTV footage and 
the statements of the complainant and other 
eyewitnesses. Learned A.G.A. further sought 
two weeks' time to obtain instructions in the 
present matter.
4. Today, learned counsel for the 
applicant has raised an additional 
contention that the investigation of the 
matter was transferred from Police Station 
Kaliyar to Police Station Gangnahar. It is 
further submitted that the Investigating 
Officer, who was conducting the 
investigation at Police Station Gangnahar, 
was promoted and posted to another police  station, however, despite his promotion and 
subsequent posting, he continued to act as 
the Investigating Officer in the present case. 
5. Learned A.G.A. is also directed to 
obtain instructions as to whether the 
investigation was transferred to Police 
Station Gangnahar or specifically to the 
concerned officer.
6. List this case on 29.10.2026.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
 15-10-2026
